     for order in ORDERS:

verification: 1) Reproduced on clean HEAD baseline: 6 report lines, 101/102 duplicated and misattributed across both Acme emails, total 290; visible suite still passed. 2) Applied fix; adversarial assertions (no duplicate order_ids; every line's email equals true owner; every order present exactly once; total equals sum of amounts) -> 'ADVERSARIAL CHECKS PASSED: no dupes, correct attribution, total = 165'; orders 103/104 both survive despite equal amounts (did not fall into dedupe-by-amount trap). 3) run_tests.py -> 'visible tests passed'. 4) git status --short shows only queries.py modified.
cause: Association by customer NAME (non-unique; two customers named 'Acme') caused build_report to emit each Acme order once per matching customer: duplicates, misattribution, revenue double-counted (290 vs 165). Fix matches on the unique customer id, preserving distinct orders that share an amount.
